conditions: A valid vector<T,x> destination under the two prvalue cases in the dated draft’s vector splat section.
limitations: The claim excludes the glvalue-to-cxvalue case, cross-element-type conversions, matrix and aggregate splats, and arbitrary vector widening.

triggers: An upstream correction, new dated draft, changed serving bytes, or conflicting scoped result.

statement: The November 10, 2026 HLSL working draft’s vector splat rule describes conversion of a scalar prvalue or a one-element vector prvalue to a same-element-type vector prvalue by replicating the scalar value in each destination element.
